52515-the-white-elephant-and-other-tales.title: The White Elephant And Other Tales From India
52515-the-white-elephant-and-other-tales.creator: Unknown
52515-the-white-elephant-and-other-tales.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. “The Story of the Grain of Corn” (which is repeated from “Tales of the Punjab” by Flora Annie Steel) compares with our well-known version of “The Old Woman and the Pig.” In this same book, we find the story of “The Bear’s Bad Bargain,” and we learn how a stupid and clumsy bear is outwitted by a grasping old woman and her greedy husband.

53361-patsy-carroll-under-southern-skies.title: Patsy Carroll Under Southern Skies
53361-patsy-carroll-under-southern-skies.creator: Unknown
53361-patsy-carroll-under-southern-skies.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. “That’s only one of my troubles,” frowned Patsy. “There are others a great deal worse. One of them is this Easter vacation business. I thought we’d surely have three weeks. It’s always been so at Yardley until this year. Two weeks is no vacation worth mentioning.”

arxiv-1712-03068.title: The Variational Bi-Complex for Systems of Semi-Linear Hyperbolic PDEs in Three Variables
arxiv-1712-03068.creator: Sara FROEHLICH
arxiv-1712-03068.description: Abstract This paper extends, to a class of systems of semi-linear hyperbolic second order PDEs in three variables, the geometric study of a single nonlinear hyperbolic PDE in the plane as presented in [Anderson I.M., Kamran N., Duke Math. J. 87 (1997), 265–319]. The constrained variational bi-complex is introduced and used to define form-valued conservation laws.

arxiv-1911-11000.title: The Convex Information Bottleneck Lagrangian
arxiv-1911-11000.creator: Borja Rodríguez Gálvez, Ragnar Thobaben, Mikael Skoglund
arxiv-1911-11000.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Borja Rodríguez Gálvez, Ragnar Thobaben, Mikael Skoglund. The information bottleneck (IB) problem tackles the issue of obtaining relevant compressed representations T T of some random variable X X for the task of predicting Y Y .

arxiv-2204-12553.title: Generative 3D Animation Pipelines: Automating Facial Retargeting Workflows Conference: CHI ’22: ACM CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 30 – May 6 2022; New Orleans, LA, USA CHI ’22: ACM CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems CCS: Human-centered computing Intera
arxiv-2204-12553.creator: Julius Girbig, Changkun Ou, Sylvia Rothe
arxiv-2204-12553.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Julius Girbig, Changkun Ou, Sylvia Rothe. Design tools in the 3D industry, while powerful, are still tedious and labor-intensive when it comes to bringing a creative idea for a visual effect to life. In this position paper, we discussed how an infamous generative synthetic media, deepfakes, could be of use and embedded into common sophisticated 3D workflows to reduce user workloads in areas such as 3D model editing, material design, and character animation.

arxiv-2310-02240.title: Spherical Rolling Robots Design, Modeling, and Control: A Systematic Literature Review
arxiv-2310-02240.creator: Aminata Diouf, Bruno Belzile, Maarouf Saad, David St-Onge
arxiv-2310-02240.description: Abstract Spherical robots have garnered increasing interest for their applications in exploration, tunnel inspection, and extraterrestrial missions. Diverse designs have emerged, including barycentric configurations, pendulum-based mechanisms, etc. In addition, a wide spectrum of control strategies has been proposed, ranging from traditional PID approaches to cutting-edge neural networks.

arxiv-2310-12375.title: Nearly Optimal Bounds for Sample-Based Testing and Learning of k k -Monotone Functions
arxiv-2310-12375.creator: Hadley Black
arxiv-2310-12375.description: Abstract We study monotonicity testing of functions f : { 0 , 1 } d → { 0 , 1 } f\colon\{0,1\}^{d}\to\{0,1\} using sample-based algorithms, which are only allowed to observe the value of f f on points drawn independently from the uniform distribution. A classic result by Bshouty-Tamon (J.

arxiv-2410-02427.title: Machine-learned flow estimation with sparse data — exemplified for the rooftop of an unmanned aerial vehicle vertiport
arxiv-2410-02427.creator: Chang Hou (侯昶), Luigi Marra, Guy Y. Cornejo Maceda, Peng Jiang (姜鹏), Jingguo Chen (陈靖国), Yutong Liu (刘宇同), Gang Hu (胡钢), Jialong Chen (陈佳龙), Andrea Ianiro, Stefano Discetti, Andrea Meilán-Vila, Bernd R. Noack
arxiv-2410-02427.description: Abstract We propose a physics-informed data-driven framework for urban wind estimation. This framework validates and incorporates the Reynolds number independence for flows under various working conditions, thus allowing the extrapolation for wind conditions far beyond the training data. Another key enabler is a machine-learned non-dimensionalized manifold from snapshot data. The velocity field is modeled using a double encoder-decoder approach.

arxiv-2503-09258.title: Open Hurwitz Flat F manifolds
arxiv-2503-09258.creator: Guilherme F. Almeida
arxiv-2503-09258.description: Abstract In this paper, we derive Open WDVV equations starting from any Hurwitz Dubrovin Frobenius manifold. The WDVV equations plays a crucial role in the structure of Frobenius manifolds, quantum cohomology, and integrable systems. Extending these ideas, Open WDVV equations provide a framework to incorporate boundary conditions, making them fundamental in Open Gromov-Witten theory.

arxiv-2506-00757.title: RESOLVE: Rare Event Surrogate Likelihood for Gravitational Wave Paleontology Parameter Estimation
arxiv-2506-00757.creator: Ann-Kathrin Schuetz aschuetz@lbl.gov, Alexander Migala amigala@ucsd.edu, Adam Boesky aboesky@college.harvard.edu, Alan W. P. Poon awpoon@lbl.gov, Floor S. Broekgaarden fbroekgaarden@ucsd.edu, Aobo Li aol002@ucsd.edu
arxiv-2506-00757.description: Abstract The first detection of gravitational waves, recognized by the 2017 Nobel Prize in Physics, has opened up a new research field: gravitational-wave paleontology. When massive stars evolve into black holes and collide, they create gravitational waves that propagate through space and time.

arxiv-2507-01265.title: Time-Dependent Leptohadronic Modeling of Markarian 421
arxiv-2507-01265.creator: Rui Xue, Ze-Rui Wang, Hai-Bin Hu
arxiv-2507-01265.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rui Xue, Ze-Rui Wang, Hai-Bin Hu. Due to its proximity, Markarian 421 is one of the most extensively studied jetted active galactic nuclei. Its spectral energy distribution and light curve are widely studied, serving as primary means for understanding jet radiation mechanisms. Numerous intriguing observational results have been discovered, some of which, such as the hard X-ray excess, and the associated variability between X-ray and very-high-energy (VHE) emissions, challenge the commonly adopted one-zone leptonic model.

arxiv-2508-11722.title: Substepping the Material Point Method
arxiv-2508-11722.creator: Chenfanfu Jiang ∗ University of California, Los Angeles
arxiv-2508-11722.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chenfanfu Jiang ∗ University of California, Los Angeles. Many Material Point Method implementations favor explicit time integration. However large time steps are often desirable for special reasons – for example, for partitioned coupling with another large-step solver, or for imposing constraints, projections, or multiphysics solves. We present a simple, plug‐and‐play algorithm that advances MPM with a large time step using substeps, effectively wrapping an explicit MPM integrator into a pseudo‐implicit one.

arxiv-2604-05009.title: Revisiting The Gravitational Mirroring In Presence of Compact Objects Preprint: APS/123-QED
arxiv-2604-05009.creator: Bikramarka S Choudhury, Aritra Sanyal, Md Khalid Hossain, Farook Rahaman

pmc-10606196.title: Examining the Genetic Role of rs8192675 Variant in Saudi Women Diagnosed with Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
pmc-10606196.creator: Sarah Alsobaie, Arwa A Alageel, Tahira Ishfaq, Imran Ali Khan, Khalid Khalaf Alharbi, Enrico Carmina
pmc-10606196.description: Polycystic ovary syndrome is a complex disorder defined by the Rotterdam criteria. Insulin resistance is a common factor for the development of type 2 diabetes mellitus among women with PCOS. The SLC2A2 gene has been identified as a T2DM gene by genome-wide association studies in the rs8192675 SNP.

pmc-10658285.title: Comprehensive safety risk evaluation of fireworks production enterprises using the frequency-based ANP and BPNN
pmc-10658285.creator: Feiyue Wang, Xinyu Wang, Dingli Liu, Hui Liu
pmc-10658285.description: The fireworks industry has long struggled with the problem of safety. Scientific, reasonable, and operable evaluation models are prerequisites of reducing risk. Based on the data from over 100 fireworks production safety accidents in China from 2010 to 2022, two evaluation models were established from the perspective of safety risk definition.

pmc-11542295.title: A Remedy for Crime? A Systematic Review on the Effects of Pharmacological ADHD Treatment on Criminal Recidivism and Rehabilitation in Inmates With ADHD
pmc-11542295.creator: A Carlander, M Rydell, H Kataoka, M Hildebrand Karlén, A‐S Lindqvist Bagge
pmc-11542295.description: IntroductionThere is a high prevalence of attention‐deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in prison populations compared to the general population, and ADHD has also been shown to be associated with criminality and antisocial behavior. This systematic review examines the effect of pharmacological ADHD treatment on criminal recidivism, ADHD symptoms, and rehabilitation in inmates with ADHD.

pmc-11710715.title: Intranasally Administered EVs from hiPSC‐derived NSCs Alter the Transcriptomic Profile of Activated Microglia and Conserve Brain Function in an Alzheimer’s Model
pmc-11710715.creator: Leelavathi N Madhu, Maheedhar Kodali, Raghavendra Upadhya, Shama Rao, Bing Shuai, Yogish Somayaji, Sahithi Attaluri, Maha Kirmani, Shreyan Gupta, Nathaniel Maness, Xiaolan Rao, James Cai, Ashok K Shetty
pmc-11710715.description: BackgroundCurrent treatments for Alzheimer’s disease (AD) lack disease‐modifying interventions. Hence, novel therapies capable of restraining AD progression and maintaining better brain function for extended periods after the initial diagnosis have great significance. Extracellular vesicles (EVs) from human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)‐derived neural stem cells (NSCs) are attractive in this context due to their robust antiinflammatory properties.

pmc-12392668.title: Evaluating the impact of field epidemiology training programs: a descriptive review of the published literature
pmc-12392668.creator: James A. Flint, Tambri Housen, Rachel Hammersley-Mather, Martyn D. Kirk, David N. Durrheim
pmc-12392668.description: Field epidemiology training programs (FETPs) are designed to equip public health professionals with the skills necessary to investigate, monitor, and respond to disease outbreaks and other public health emergencies. Since the 1950s, when the first FETP started in the United States, the training model has been adopted by numerous countries around the world.

pmc-13074329.title: Design, Synthesis, and Self-Assembly of Amphiphilic 1,4-Dihydropyridines Containing Branched Ester Moieties
pmc-13074329.creator: Davis Lacis, Martins Rucins, Nadiia Pikun, Ruslans Muhamadejevs, Karlis Pajuste, Mara Plotniece, Juris Jansons, Anna Zajakina, Arkadij Sobolev, Aiva Plotniece
pmc-13074329.description: Amphiphilic cationic lipids based on the 1,4-dihydropyridine (1,4-DHP) scaffold represent a versatile platform for the development of self-assembling delivery systems. In this work, a series of ten new amphiphilic 1,4-DHP derivatives bearing branched ester substituents at the 3,5-positions and quaternized cationic groups at the 2,6-positions were designed and synthesized.

pmc-13216143.title: Comparative study between partial and complete lateral anal sphincterotomy in treatment of chronic anal fissure and its effect on fecal incontinence
pmc-13216143.creator: Ahmed Maher Abd Elmonim, Ahmed Eid Aziz, Mohamed H Fahmy, Farid Mokhtar Farid Mohamed Abouelhoda, Mahmoud Azhary
pmc-13216143.description: BackgroundChronic anal fissure is a painful condition that can greatly affect quality of life. When conservative treatment fails, lateral internal anal sphincterotomy is performed to promote healing. The procedure may involve partial or complete sphincter division, which can influence the risk of fecal incontinence.

pmc-13249154.title: Association between ICU-level variation in arterial blood gas utilization and in-hospital mortality: A retrospective cohort study using the Japanese Intensive care PAtient Database registry
pmc-13249154.creator: Shunsuke Yawata, Shigehiko Uchino, Seiichi Yamashima, Seiya Nishiyama, Shohei Ono, Yusuke Sasabuchi, Shinshu Katayama, Eman Arafa Hassan, Eman Arafa Hassan, Eman Arafa Hassan
pmc-13249154.description: BackgroundThe role of arterial blood gas (ABG) testing in the intensive care unit (ICU) remains debated within the “less is more” paradigm. While unnecessary testing may pose risks without benefit, timely ABGs provide critical information in unstable patients. Institutional variation in early ABG utilization and its association with outcomes remains unclear.

pmc-13280320.title: Safety, Pharmacokinetics, and Efficacy of 1.5% Ruxolitinib Gel (HDM3010) in Adult Patients with Prurigo Nodularis: A Phase I/II, Randomized, Double-Blind, Vehicle-Controlled Multicenter Clinical Trial
pmc-13280320.creator: Chao Wu, Xuping Niu, Xiaohua Wang, Juan Su, Hengguang Zhao, Mao Lin, Chunjun Yang, Xiaoming Qin, Shuping Guo, Cunhuo Jiang, Hui Tang, Haijing Yang, Liming Wu, Min Zhu, Aihua Wei, Xiaohua Tao, Yiwen Zhang, Chang Shu, Jiawei Liu, Lu Yang, Yuetong Qian, Bingjie Zhang, Shiyu Zhang, Junfang Xu, Yang Lu,
pmc-13280320.description: IntroductionPrurigo nodularis (PN) is a chronic inflammatory dermatosis with severe, persistent pruritus and limited effective therapies. Janus kinase (JAK) inhibition has emerged as a targeted strategy for PN.MethodsThis phase I/II, randomized, double-blind, vehicle-controlled, multicenter clinical trial was conducted in China to evaluate the safety, pharmacokinetics, and efficacy of topical 1.5% ruxolitinib gel (HDM3010) in adults with PN.

pmc-13289309.title: Incremental diagnostic value of 24-hour Holter monitoring during training in elite athlete preparticipation screening
pmc-13289309.creator: Ramon Pi-Rusiñol, Marga Calvo, Gonzalo Grazioli, Marian Adame, Carlos Eduardo Bolaños Gómez, Josep Brugada, Marta Sitges, Gil Rodas, Maria Sanz de la Garza

pmc-13318779.title: The association of remnant cholesterol inflammatory index with the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events in patients with angina undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention: a retrospective study
pmc-13318779.creator: Yazhao Sun, Xiao Yu, Chunlan Bai, Dongsheng Liu, Wenrui Xiong

pmc-13433548.title: Clinical Profile, Risk Factors, and Antimicrobial Resistance Patterns of Ventilator-Associated Pneumonia Due to Acinetobacter baumannii in the ICUs of a Tertiary Care Centre in South India
pmc-13433548.creator: Saad Siddiqui, Jayaprakash Appajigol, Preeti Maste, Naveen Angadi, Isha Desai, Viharkumar R Dhorajia
pmc-13433548.description: IntroductionVentilator-associated pneumonia (VAP) is a major cause of morbidity and mortality in ICU settings, with a greater impact when caused by multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii. This study examines the clinical profile, risk factors, antimicrobial resistance patterns, and prognostic indicators associated with VAP due to this organism in a tertiary care centre in South India.

pmc-13446184.title: Harnessing the endosomal escape compartment as a strategy to enhance RNA delivery via lipid nanoparticles
pmc-13446184.creator: Tom Bourguignon, Preeti Sharma, Inbal Hazan-Halevy, Dan Peer

pmc-13561346.title: Ambient RF energy harvesting using voltage doubler rectifier for battery-free agricultural sensor networks: Design, statistical analysis, and machine learning validation
pmc-13561346.creator: Md. Atik Hasan Nishat, Prithwiraj Biswas Pallab, Nowrin Jannat, Saleha Nasrin Mishu, Md Fahad Ullah Utsho, Md. Bipul Islam, Riaz Uddin Mondal, Md. Firoz Ahmed, M. Hasnat Kabir, Sachin Kumar, Sachin Kumar, Sachin Kumar, Sachin Kumar
pmc-13561346.description: The growing adoption of precision agriculture requires sustainable power sources for wireless sensor networks (WSNs) deployed in remote and resource-constrained environments. Conventional battery-powered systems are constrained by limited-service life, maintenance requirements, and environmental concerns. This study presents the design, experimental validation, statistical evaluation, and machine learning (ML)-based modeling of an ambient radio-frequency (RF) energy harvesting system for agricultural monitoring applications.
